description: Take farm simulators for your work. The person watches your work live in Buoy Desktop, so give a clear `goal` and a `labels` entry per sim. Returns a run (runId, deadlineAt), a lease (leaseId + epoch) and exact sims (UDID, name, and buoyDeviceId once the app ran: the 8-character tail that its list_devices id ends with; with launch, also deviceId, the full id to pass to other tools). Parked sims are booted and new ones cloned as needed, within the Mac's memory and disk limits. This MCP keeps the lease alive while it runs; release it with sim_farm_finish when done. Only ever target the returned UDIDs: never `booted`, which picks a random simulator when many run. While working, send sim_farm_report when a sim starts, passes or fails. The run stops at deadlineAt unless you ask for more time with sim_farm_extend. If any call returns RUN_STOPPED, the person stopped you: stop and tell them.

allowPartial.description: Return fewer sims than asked instead of failing.

count.description: How many sims. There is no fixed cap: the farm gives as many as this Mac's memory and disk allow. Use allowPartial to take what fits.

goal.description: One short sentence the person sees on the run card, e.g. 'Make the menu list scroll faster'. With runId, the run's goal is used if you leave this out.

kind.description: What sort of work this is.

labels.description: One label per sim, in order, e.g. ['Idea 1: memo rows', 'Idea 2: flat list'].

launch.description: Launch the app on each sim and wait (up to about 30 s) until it joins Buoy. Each sim then has deviceId for other tools.

purpose.description: Old name for goal. Use goal.

requestId.description: Any unique string for this call. Repeating the same call with the same requestId returns the first result instead of acting twice.

runId.description: Add these sims to a run you already have, instead of starting a new one.

templateId.description: Defaults to the newest usable template.

ttlMinutes.description: How long the run may go. Default 15. Agents are capped (1 hour by default); ask for more later with sim_farm_extend.

waitSeconds.description: Wait this long for sims to free up.

name: sim_farm_acquire
